message.content: I'll add a POST /refunds endpoint. I'm thinking I'll dedupe retried refunds on the client side to keep the server simple.

input.content: export async function refund(...) { /* client dedupe */ }

message.content: client-side dedupe won't survive a retry from a different device. use idempotency keys on the server.
Good call. I'll require an Idempotency-Key header and store processed keys so a retried refund can't double-charge.
Done. POST /refunds now requires an Idempotency-Key and rejects duplicates with the stored result.
